units.source_en: As Hatarō boarded the boat carrying the body, Gorō also timidly clambered into the boat holding Takechiyo’s palanquin.
units.source_zh: 波太郎登上载着尸首的船只时，五郎也战战兢兢钻进那艘放有竹千代所乘轿子的船里。

units.source_en: Nobumitsu stood at the landing.
units.source_zh: 宣光站在泊船处。

paragraphs.source_zh: 波太郎登上载着尸首的船只时，五郎也战战兢兢钻进那艘放有竹千代所乘轿子的船里。宣光站在泊船处。

paragraphs.source_en: “Please get inside the palanquin.” A retainer urged him, but he merely gave a slight wave of his hand and remained standing there, letting the rain wash over him.

units.source_en: “Please get inside the palanquin.”
units.source_zh: “请您进轿子里面吧。”

units.source_en: A retainer urged him, but he merely gave a slight wave of his hand and remained standing there, letting the rain wash over him.
units.source_zh: 家臣劝道，他只是轻轻摇了摇手，依然站在那里，任凭雨水冲刷。

paragraphs.source_zh: “请您进轿子里面吧。”家臣劝道，他只是轻轻摇了摇手，依然站在那里，任凭雨水冲刷。

paragraphs.source_en: Before long, the boat carrying Takechiyo and Gorō left shore first, followed by the escort boat and finally Hatarō’s; soon all had departed. Nobumitsu remained where he was, gazing silently after them until they vanished across the sea veiled in fine rain.

units.source_en: Before long, the boat carrying Takechiyo and Gorō left shore first, followed by the escort boat and finally Hatarō’s; soon all had departed.
units.source_zh: 不久，竹千代和五郎的那只船首先离岸，接着是护卫的船，最后是波太郎，他们都离开了。

units.source_en: Nobumitsu remained where he was, gazing silently after them until they vanished across the sea veiled in fine rain.
units.source_zh: 宣光依然站在那里，静静地凝望着，直到他们消失在细雨蒙蒙的海面。

paragraphs.source_zh: 不久，竹千代和五郎的那只船首先离岸，接着是护卫的船，最后是波太郎，他们都离开了。宣光依然站在那里，静静地凝望着，直到他们消失在细雨蒙蒙的海面。
